The denominator requires 'increased risk of perinatal depression', which depends on clinician assessment of risk factors; encoded as uncomputable, so the rule as a whole will report 'not computable' unless a risk flag is added.
New concept 'perinatal_depression_counseling' (counseling interventions such as CBT or interpersonal therapy for perinatal depression prevention) is not in the vocabulary.
Referral to counseling (as opposed to provided counseling) is encoded as uncomputable because referral completion is not reliably in structured data.
The text specifies no time window, counseling type, number of sessions or timing relative to pregnancy/postpartum; the measurement-year window is derived and requires human review.
The text does not define the duration of the postpartum period; the 'postpartum' concept is used as-is.
